def factor_volume_weighted_drawdown_location_40d(df):
    """Volume-weighted location of close within trailing 40-day drawdown range; high values indicate sustained buying pressure near range highs."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    peak = close.rolling(40, min_periods=20).max()
    trough = close.rolling(40, min_periods=20).min()
    drawdown_range = (peak - trough).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    location = (close - trough) / drawdown_range
    location = location.clip(0.0, 1.0)
    weighted = (volume * location).rolling(20, min_periods=5).sum()
    volume_sum = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=5).sum().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = weighted / volume_sum
    factor = factor.fillna(0.0)
    factor.name = "factor_volume_weighted_drawdown_location_40d"
    return factor
